get.summary:
Lists all management keys in the account identified by the given ID.
Required permissions:
- read:management_keys

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

delete.summary:
Deletes a management key in the account identified by the given ID.
Required permissions:
- delete:management_keys

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

parameters.name: managementKeyId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the management key (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

post.summary:
Creates a management key in the account identified by the given ID.
Required permissions:
- write:management_keys

parameters.name: managementKey.accountId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the account (in GUID format).
This is a required field.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the management key (in GUID format).
This is a read-only field and will be available after a management key is created.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the management key was created.
This is a read-only field and will be available after a management key is created.

prefix.description:
Prefix for the management key, this represents the first bytes of the key.
This is a read-only field and will be available after a management key is created.

key.description:
The value of the key, to be used to authenticate requests to the Qdrant Cloud API.
This is a read-only field and will be available only once in the response of CreateManagementKey.
You should securely store this key and it should be handled as a secret.

createdByEmail.description:
The email of the user the management key is attributed to.
This is a read-only field. If the key is created by another management key, the email is inherited
from that key, so the responsible user stays visible. It is empty when no user can be attributed,
for example for keys created by the system.

createdByActorType.description:
How the management key was created, either directly by a user or by another management key.
This is a read-only field.

AuthServiceCreateManagementKeyBody.title: CreateManagementKeyRequest is the request for the CreateManagementKey function

v1ActorType.description:
ActorType specifies the type of actor that can call a method.

 - ACTOR_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: Default, unspecified actor type. Should generally not be used explicitly in options
unless to signify an error or uninitialized state.
 - ACTOR_TYPE_USER: Represents a human user, typically authenticated via an identity provider (Auth0).
 - ACTOR_TYPE_MANAGEMENT_KEY: Represents a programmatic access key, also called management key,
that is not be tied to a specific user or service account identity, but rather an account.
 - ACTOR_TYPE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT: Represents a service account or machine user, often used for M2M communication.
This is for internal platform use only.

v1CreateManagementKeyResponse.title: CreateManagementKeyResponse is the response from the CreateManagementKey function

v1DeleteManagementKeyResponse.title: DeleteManagementKeyResponse is the response from the DeleteManagementKey function

A ManagementKey represents a management key of a Qdrant Cloud account.
This management key grants access to the Qdrant Cloud API.
